acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the unchecked deferred dispatcher ledger save at immutable current source using an actual controlled write failure; retain the difference between emitted in-memory state and unchanged persisted ledger.

Make relevant private-ledger save failures explicit without losing current active workers or falsely reporting persisted accounting; define normal failure/restart behavior and preserve original error evidence.
Retain focused failure/restart/worker-accounting tests, independent review and required evidence/integration; do not restore stale ledger snapshots or claim power-loss durability.
body: Observed during issue468 Gate A, distinct from its newly added checked token-admission path. Current base f51f3c9e6fbfc5a6b219692e8bf46e4e43297a36 internal/tasks/dispatch/loop.go defers ledger.save but ignores its returned error. Fresh scratch-only Darwin Go1.27.1 test initialized a dispatcher baseline, made its program directory read/execute-only, confirmed CreateTemp failed, changed the ticket status, then called Tick. Tick returned success and published changed state while state.json remained byte-identical. Fixture directory permissions were restored and dispatcher closed. This is confirmed error suppression in current source, not a production-crash or progress-token qualification. Installed Core163/Tasks202 version labels are not qualification evidence; test exercised source at the pinned base. Existing exact native searches for ledger.save, ledger save and dispatcher persistence returned no open dedicated equivalent. Issue468 will fix only checked token admission/accounting; broad legacy ledger failure handling remains separate. Expected: a failed required private persistence step remains an explicit failure/uncertainty, preserving current worker identities and accounting. Actual: no Tick error despite failed persistence. No repair, completion or runtime authority claimed.
